items.prompt:
The attached images are ART STYLE references only (board items from a merge-2 mobile game). Match the RENDERING of their items exactly, but do NOT copy their items, layout, logos or text. Do NOT draw snorkels, flippers, diving masks, shells, sand castles or seaweed.

RENDER: merge-2 item icons that look like small 3D toy models under soft studio light. Chunky, rounded, slightly squashed proportions. NO outlines, edges only slightly darker in the same hue. One soft light from the top-left, soft ambient occlusion, a small soft contact shadow under each item. Real material feel: glossy inflatable PVC vinyl with bright specular highlights, subtle seam lines and a small valve, gentle air-filled bulges. Saturated, clean colors, not pastel. Few large shapes, no tiny details; sparkles only on the top level. Each icon reads clearly at 100 px.

CONTENT: an item sheet of 5 separate icons for a beach-themed merge chain "Pool Floats", level 1 to 5, each level bigger and more valuable, same camera angle (slight top-down 3/4 view) and same scale per cell, each icon filling about 85% of its cell:
1) a pair of orange arm floaties
2) a red-and-white striped swim ring
3) a big yellow rubber-duck float
4) a white unicorn float with a rainbow mane and gold horn
5) a yellow banana boat float with handles, golden glow and a few sparkles
Layout: 3 icons on the top row, 2 centered on the bottom row, on a plain flat very light background with NO cells, tiles or frames. No text, no numbers, no labels, no watermark.
